summary: Iteration 49: tested the new in-app feedback system (public POST + admin list/delete) and the theme-welcome realm-peek. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (short-message 422, success 200 with ok:true, admin GET requires auth 401, list newest-first with all expected fields incl. id/created_at/ip/ua and no _id leak, delete removes doc, delete-missing returns ok:false). Frontend home-footer feedback dialog opens, submit button disabled below 3 chars, submits with success toast, dialog closes. Realm peek works — clicking a theme tile drops container opacity to ~0.06 with the 'Previewing your realm…' hint pill, then eases back after ~2.4s, and 'Enter Fork·Fate' still dismisses. Found and fixed a CRITICAL bug on /admin: FeedbackList JSX was referenced but never imported, causing the whole Admin page to crash with 'FeedbackList is not defined' Uncaught runtime error. Added the missing import; page now renders, feedback-section displays entries with per-row delete (window.confirm auto-accepted), and the delete toast fires.

ui_bugs.issue: FeedbackList was used in JSX but never imported → the entire Admin page crashed with 'FeedbackList is not defined' after login. Fixed by adding `import { FeedbackList } from '../components/admin/FeedbackList';`

action_items: Verify the FeedbackList import fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx (added by testing agent). No functional changes beyond the missing import.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx uses FeedbackList without an import — build didn't catch it because CRA/webpack treats undefined identifiers as runtime errors only. Consider adding an ESLint no-undef rule or a smoke test that mounts the Admin route.
The public POST /api/feedback fires an email best-effort in a fire-and-forget task; RESEND_API_KEY is empty so a 'Email not sent' warn is expected per instructions — noted, not a bug.

FeedbackDialog: no client-side email format validation; the backend also does not validate email format on FeedbackCreate (only length). Non-blocking but worth adding a Pydantic regex like FeedbackCreate.email since the field is stored/rendered.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_iter49* feedback entries were created during testing; the module-scoped admin_session deletes 'TEST_iter49' one, and the UI test deleted a second one via the admin panel. One residual 'TEST_iter49_ui feedback from playwright' entry from the UI submit may remain — main agent can delete via /admin if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feedback endpoints live in /app/backend/routes/admin.py (submit_feedback, list_feedback, delete_feedback). Pytest file test_iter49_feedback.py covers all three. The Admin page now correctly imports FeedbackList; if that regresses, the whole /admin route crashes post-login with an Uncaught runtime error banner. Rate limit on POST /api/feedback is 10/min per IP.
rca of the issue: Root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx rendered <FeedbackList feedback={feedback} deleteFeedback={deleteFeedback} /> at line 410 but never imported the component. React threw 'FeedbackList is not defined' during render, which the react-error-overlay caught as an Uncaught runtime error, blanking the admin UI. Reproduction: load /admin, log in with the admin password → red error banner appears; feedback-section not visible. Mitigation applied: added `import { FeedbackList } from '../components/admin/FeedbackList';` next to the other admin subcomponent imports. Verified by re-running the Playwright flow: no runtime error banner, feedback-section rendered, entries listed, per-row delete removes an entry and the 'Feedback deleted' toast fires.
